name: consent-summary
title: Consent compliance summary
for_each: select id, code from consents where status = 'active' order by code

sections.title: The consent
sections.sql: select r.authority_ref as reference, r.holder, s.name as site, r.regulator, replace(r.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, r.activity, r.granted_on, r.commenced_on as given_effect_on, r.expires_on, r.renew_by, r.renewal_lodged_on, r.renewal_ref from consent_register r join sites s on s.code = r.site where r.id = $1

sections.title: Conditions and when each was last met
sections.sql: select d.number as condition, d.kind, d.summary, d.owner, d.last_done as last_met, d.next_due, d.days_overdue from condition_due d where d.consent = (select code from consents where id = $1) order by length(d.number), d.number

sections.title: Monitoring results, last 12 months
sections.sql: select point, parameter, count(*)::int as results, min(value)::float as lowest, max(value)::float as highest, max(coalesce(max_value, min_value))::float as limit_value, count(*) filter (where verdict in ('over limit','under minimum'))::int as breaches from reading_check where consent = (select code from consents where id = $1) and taken_on >= current_date - 365 group by point, parameter order by point, parameter

sections.title: Incidents and what the regulator was told
sections.sql: select code, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, found_on, notify_by, notified_on, regulator_ref, status from incident_register where consent = (select code from consents where id = $1) order by found_on desc

sections.title: Inspections and notices
sections.sql: select 'inspection' as record, code, inspected_on as on_date, replace(grade, '_', ' ') as outcome, findings as detail from inspections where consent_id = $1 union all select 'notice', code, issued_on, replace(kind, '_', ' ') || ' ' || reference, requirement from notices where consent_id = $1 order by on_date desc

name: incident-report
title: Non-compliance incident report
for_each: select id, code from incidents order by code

sections.title: The incident
sections.sql: select i.code, s.name as site, c.authority_ref as consent, co.number as condition, replace(i.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, i.found_on, i.description, i.cause, case when i.closed_on is null then 'open' else 'closed ' || i.closed_on end as status from incidents i join consents c on c.id = i.consent_id join sites s on s.id = c.site_id left join conditions co on co.id = i.condition_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: The result that triggered it
sections.sql: select rc.point, rc.taken_on, rc.parameter, case when rc.qualifier = '=' then '' else rc.qualifier end || rc.value::float as result, rc.unit, coalesce('max ' || rc.max_value::float, 'min ' || rc.min_value::float) as limit_value, rc.verdict from incidents i join reading_check rc on rc.reading_id = i.reading_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Telling the regulator
sections.sql: select r.regulator, r.notify_by as to_be_told_by, r.notified_on as told_on, i.notified_by as told_by, r.regulator_ref as their_reference, r.days_to_notify from incident_register r join incidents i on i.id = r.id where r.id = $1

sections.title: Corrective action and close-out
sections.sql: select corrective_action, closed_on, closeout_note from incidents where id = $1

sections.title: Record of every step
sections.sql: select a.created_at as recorded_at, a.actor as by, a.command as step, a.detail from activity a join incidents i on i.code = a.record_id where i.id = $1 order by a.id
